financial_dashboard.title: PT Indofood CBP Tbk Financial Performance Dashboard
financial_dashboard.description: A Power BI financial performance dashboard of PT Indofood CBP Tbk (2023–2025) to monitor profitability, liquidity, and leverage trends.
financial_dashboard.problem: Assessing the financial health of a giant FMCG emiten like PT Indofood CBP Tbk from raw financial statement spreadsheets is often slow and cumbersome. Management required instant visibility to track the impact of rising Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) on net margins and compare multi-year debt leverage vs equity structures.
financial_dashboard.solution: Integrated 3-year balance sheets and income statements (2023–2025) into a unified Power BI data model. Built custom DAX measures for profitability (GPM, NPM), liquidity (Current Ratio), and leverage (DER, DAR) while designing an interactive layout featuring asset/liability breakdowns.
financial_dashboard.impact: Delivered instant visibility showing that net profit grew significantly by ▲ 30.3% in 2025 to Rp 9.22 Bn due to operating margin efficiency (NPM rose to 12.3%), backed by an exceptionally strong liquidity position (Current Ratio of 4.15x) and a healthy debt leverage (DER) of 0.84x.
steps: Extracting annual balance sheets and income statements of PT Indofood CBP Tbk (2023–2025) from the IDX.
Performing data cleaning and nominal unit transformations (removing raw decimal figures) using Power Query.
Designing a structured star schema to link historical financial statement lines with dimension calendar tables.
Developing custom DAX measures to calculate NPM, GPM, ROE, Current Ratio, and Debt-to-Equity Ratio (DER).
Designing the interactive dashboard layout in Power BI Desktop featuring liquidity, solvency, and asset breakdowns.

budget_vs_actual.title: Budget vs Actual Monitoring Dashboard
budget_vs_actual.description: Built an interactive Budget vs Actual monitoring system using Microsoft Excel, Power Query, and Power BI to track expenditure performance by division, month, and cost category while detecting over-budget risks early.
budget_vs_actual.problem: Many budget monitoring workflows still rely on manual spreadsheets requiring repetitive consolidation and checking. This makes it difficult for finance teams to monitor actual spending against budget, identify divisions nearing threshold limits, and prepare variance analysis periodically.
budget_vs_actual.solution: Constructed a centralized Star Schema data model in Power BI integrating FactActual, FactBudget, DimMonth, DimDivision, and DimCategory. Calculated dynamic financial measures using DAX (Total Budget, Actual, Variance, Utilization, Remaining Budget) and implemented an Early Warning System with status thresholds (<85% Normal, 85%–<100% Warning, ≥100% Over Budget).
budget_vs_actual.impact: Reduced dependency on manual spreadsheet consolidation and provided a dynamic Budget vs Actual reporting solution in Power BI. Delivered interactive drill-down analysis across division, month, and cost category to monitor over-budget risks in real-time.
steps: Data Structure Preparation: Compiled 2026 budget and actual transaction datasets covering 5 divisions (Operations, HR, Marketing, IT, Administration) with granular transaction logs and monthly budget allocations.

Data Cleaning & Validation: Performed data auditing in Microsoft Excel & Power Query including data type validation, division/category standardization, duplicate removal, and month alignment for Power BI.

Data Modeling (Star Schema): Designed a Star Schema data model in Power BI connecting fact tables (FactActual, FactBudget) and dimension tables (DimMonth, DimDivision, DimCategory) for dynamic filtering.

DAX & Budget Monitoring: Developed DAX measures for Total Budget, Total Actual, Variance, Budget Utilization, Remaining Budget, and Budget Status with color-coded alert thresholds (<85% Normal, 85%–<100% Warning, ≥100% Over Budget).

Dashboard Development: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard featuring KPI Cards, Division Breakdown, Monthly Trend, Utilization Bars, Early Warning Table, and interactive Slicers (Month, Division, Cost Category).
